digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and bridge delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows delegate delivery to core push entrypoints, removing inline CAS loops and raw-git exemptions.
Workflow delivery is strict and synchronous, remaining red on exhausted failure while core owns retry and CAS recovery.
Reconciler author identity, exact commit subject, and existing reconciler contracts are preserved across the migration.
Python library and MCP push interfaces retain best-effort defaults; only strict workflow adapters change.
Tests verify single complete core push action per workflow, absent inline fetch/merge/retry, and correct red-on-rejection behavior.
Legacy reconcile and push contracts remain available; reverting workflow calls restores prior inline loops with no data migration.
